cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded Club Vistara card with IDFC providing CV Points on flight bookings, milestone vouchers, and travel perks for frequent flyers.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Up to 20% discount at more than 1,500 restaurants across India.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the dining partner’s platform using your registered account. Explore available dining and order-in offers, select your preferred meals or restaurants, and redeem the offer at payment. Use your IDFC Club Vistara credit card to enjoy enhanced savings and perks.

benefitRows.name: Golf
benefitRows.offer: 4 complimentary rounds of green fees per calendar year (1 round in a 1 calendar month).|12 complimentary golf lessons per calendar year (1 lesson per calendar month).|50% off on the green fee beyond complimentary sessions.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To place a golf game/ lesson request, please call 1800-102-6263. Further, for any queries under this golf program, you may write to the support email ID: mastercardindiagolf@apexlynx.net
